// F11 fixture: the imported route table tolerates a trailing comma in the tuple
// form and detects routes written with `OPERATIONAL_TOOLS.set`. Node imports it
// as the throwaway root's host/tool-registry.js.
export const OPERATIONAL_TOOLS = new Map([
  ['tower_batch', 'exposeBatch',],
  [
    'tower_test',
    'exposeTests',
  ],
])
OPERATIONAL_TOOLS.set('tower_merge', 'exposeBatch')
OPERATIONAL_TOOLS.set("tower_doctor", "exposeDoctor")
